title: The mean analytic rank of quadratic twists of elliptic curves
summary: For every elliptic curve over ℚ, we prove that the average analytic rank of its quadratic twists tends to 1/2 when signed squarefree twist parameters are ordered by absolute value. This resolves Goldfeld's mean analytic-rank conjecture in this counting convention.
family_title: Goldfeld’s conjecture: densities and mean analytic rank

review.reason: Proves Goldfeld's mean analytic-rank conjecture for quadratic twists of elliptic curves.
